ios.desc:
Teezy is your all-in-one solution for managing dental care, whether for yourself or your family. Track individual teeth, schedule appointments, visualize your dental health, and manage multiple profiles—all in one app. Teezy makes it easy to stay on top of everything.

Key Features:

- Track Tooth Health: Add detailed records for individual teeth or monitor your overall dental condition.
- Manage Appointments: Schedule dentist visits, set reminders, and receive notifications so you never miss an appointment.
- Teeth Map: Visualize your teeth with detailed mapping systems that make it easy to understand and analyze your dental health.
- Multiple Profiles: Manage dental records for your entire family or multiple individuals with ease.

Teezy helps you stay organized, informed, and in control, whether you’re managing your own care or looking after loved ones.

Teezy APP REQUIRES A SUBSCRIPTION FOR USE
